# dsh-composer-ease
English | 中文
## Summary
`dsh-composer-ease` is a DSH bundle plugin that adds a completion popup to the DSH Web composer, wit
h bracket and quote pairing: brackets and quotes pair up, typing an opener over a selection wraps it
, a closer over an existing closer is skipped, backspace removes an empty pair, and a completion pop
up opens after two characters. The browser half is plain DOM; the server half exposes two read-only
loopback routes and writes nothing.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Desktop (Electron) uses its own plugin manager; `dsh plugin --profile desktop` is rejected by the CL
I. When developing, the browser half is read from disk on every request (refresh applies), while the
server half needs a `dsh web` restart.
## Use this package
| Action | Key / trigger | Behaviour |
| Auto pair | `(` `[` `{` `"` `'` backtick, full-width family | caret between the pair; no pairing a

fter a path/identifier character, or when text follows the caret |
| Wrap selection | type any opene

r over a selection | `text` becomes `(text)`; single-line selections only (see boundaries) |
| Type-
over / delete empty pair | closer already to the right / backspace inside `()` | no duplicate; both

sides removed |
| Complete | two characters, or `Ctrl+Space` | popup: draft words, language tables,

workspace files, model ids, snippets |
| Accept / navigate | `Tab` or click / `↑` `↓` | Enter stays

the send key; `←` `→` `Home` `End` dismiss the popup and only move the caret |
| Dismiss | `Esc` | `
Shift+Enter` still inserts a newline |
Completion follows the context: a fenced block selects the language table, otherwise the draft and t
he visible conversation vote, then the language you have been accepting candidates from.
## Understand the implementation
- `lib/index.js` — server half: `/dsh-composer-ease/words` and `/config.json`, both behind a loopbac

k trust fence; ranking uses `lib/fuzzy.js` (VS Code's `fuzzyScore`, copied verbatim).
- `lib/client/
*.js` — browser half, nine fragments concatenated into `lib/client.js` by `tools/build-client.mjs` (

the host loads exactly one file).
- Chinese candidates come from the dictionary (`lib/cjk-lexicon.js
`) only: the prefix is matched against the word list, so word length follows the data instead of a f

ixed cap.
- The popup is plain DOM anchored to the caret; it never touches the host editor's data mo

cap.
- The popup is plain DOM anchored to the caret; it never touches the host editor's data model.
## Boundaries and known limits
See docs/boundaries-and-implementation.md for the measured list (multiline wrapping, insertion limit
s, IME behaviour, squiggle geometry) and the reason behind each.
## Development and tests
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The host composer is Lexical: it ignores `sel.modify(...)`, ignores `beforeinput`'s `preventDefault`
, and does not guarantee an `input` event — selection work uses flattened offsets plus explicit Rang
es and cross-frame verification.
## Sources and licenses
- Interaction design follows Visual Studio Code (MIT); no source copied except `lib/fuzzy.js` (verba

tim, see THIRD-PARTY.md).
- Word-table data comes from monaco-editor, codemirror/lang-html, codemirr
or/lang-css, MDN browser-compat-data and jieba's dictionary; each entry in THIRD-PARTY.md records re

po, commit, files and the full license text.
- This plugin: MIT (see LICENSE).
## Dev note

- Change `lib/client/*.js`, then `npm run build`; never edit `lib/client.js`.
- Every convention has
a runnable check under `tools/check-*.mjs`; CI only runs them (`.github/workflows/checks.yml`, ubun

tu + windows, one run per branch via `concurrency`).
- Release: bump `package.json`, add a CHANGELOG
entry with the commit sha, then `npm run check:all`.
